title: Dispatch: PR #458 review fixes — zero-quantity resolution, scoped accepts, stale exceptions, repurchase regression (attempt 1)
description:
Fixes for the four PR #458 review findings (review ID 4731750399, branch eshyra-f0nz). Parent spec: eshyra-f0nz. Defect context beads: eshyra-eks3 (items 1), eshyra-2n3n (items 2-3), eshyra-4ygd (item 4).

Branch/worktree: this bead's id, cut from eshyra-f0nz.

## Item 1 (P1) — zero-quantity reviews are still permanently quarantined

`giveItem` permits quantity 0 (domainMutations.ts ~233: non-negative integer), and migration 0022 reclassifies oversized-stack reviews with quantity <= 100 INCLUDING 0 to malformed-evidence — but `adoptMagicItem` (itemAdoption.ts ~281) rejects `quantity < 1` BEFORE reading the review, so a zero-quantity quarantined row can never be resolved.

Supervisor decision — implement exactly this:
- In `adoptMagicItem`, permit quantity 0 ONLY when BOTH an existing review row AND an input.resolution are present (i.e. a GM is resolving a quarantine); all other calls keep the current positive-integer rejection.
- When such a resolution succeeds on a quantity-0 row: record the resolution (existing recordItemAdoptionResolution path), clear the review, then DELETE the empty inventory row instead of binding it (nothing physical remains; resolution evidence intentionally survives row deletion per the 0018 table comments). Return the existing result shape with `adopted: true`, `instanceIds: []`, and the original id as `originalInstanceId`.
- Tests (packages/core/test/itemAdoption.test.ts): a reclassified malformed-evidence review on a quantity-0 row resolves via discard-evidence; afterwards the inventory row is gone, the review is gone, and the inventory_adoption_resolution row records the action. Also assert a quantity-0 adoption WITHOUT a review/resolution still rejects.

## Item 2 (P2) — record-wide accepts suppress a whole direction

In packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts, FORWARD/REVERSE_NUMERIC_CONSERVATION_ACCEPTS suppress EVERY dice and DC finding for the listed record in that direction (e.g. apparatus-of-the-crab's DC 20 accept would also hide loss of its typed 2d6). Convert both record-wide accept maps into value-scoped exceptions:
- Extend the existing token-scoped mechanism to DCs (e.g. keys like `<record-key>|forward|dc:20` alongside dice `<record-key>|forward|4d4`), reusing each record's existing rationale on each scoped entry.
- To enumerate exactly which values each record currently needs suppressed, temporarily empty the accept maps and read the gate's findings; convert precisely those findings to scoped exceptions. Remove the record-wide maps entirely (including their bottom-of-test key assertions) in favor of the scoped exhaustive assertion.

## Item 3 (P2) — stale exceptions must fail

`usedExceptions.add(exceptionKey)` currently fires whenever the token exists at all, even when the exact match also exists and the exception suppresses nothing. Mark an exception "used" ONLY when it actually suppressed a would-be finding (the token/DC was missing from the other side). Add a targeted unit: a synthetic record whose prose token IS exactly present in mechanics plus a pointless exception for it → the exhaustive used-exceptions assertion fails (assert via the helper's returned usedExceptions rather than a failing test, e.g. expect the helper NOT to mark it used).

## Item 4 (P2) — restore the stateful repurchase success regression

packages/core/test/domainMutations.test.ts "reacquires the exact sold row without resetting state or attunement" (~line 1173) now only asserts the sold+returned rejection; the successful PAID repurchase of that stateful row is never exercised. Extend the same test (or add a sibling) so that after the rejection it performs `reacquireItem` with basis 'repurchased' and an exact payment (seed the wallet first; see currencyTools.test.ts for the payment shape), then asserts: custody restored on the ORIGINAL row id, item_state json unchanged, attunement row still present, wallet debited, and the custody event records the payment_event_id.

## Verification

`npm ci` first, then `npm run verify:worktree`. Item 2/3 touch an SRD gate test: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md — no expectation weakening; every scoped exception keeps a source-backed rationale. Commit on this branch only.
notes:
Completed in commit d1a53f7.

Implemented:
- adoptMagicItem now permits quantity 0 only for an existing adoption review with an explicit resolution; successful discard-evidence resolution records durable evidence, clears quarantine, deletes the empty inventory row, and returns adopted=true with instanceIds=[].
- Added zero-quantity resolution and rejection regressions.
- Replaced record-wide SRD numeric-conservation accepts with exact record/direction/token and record/direction/DC exceptions, preserving rationales; stale exceptions are counted only when they suppress a missing value.
- Restored successful stateful sold-row repurchase coverage, including original row/state/attunement preservation, wallet debit, and payment_event_id linkage.

Verification: npm ci; npm run verify:worktree passed (Biome/hidden-Unicode, typecheck, 261 test files, 4655 passed, 19 skipped). No new follow-up bead was needed; existing eshyra-u5wn tracks the deferred staff-of-striking typed-damage question.
